gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.409129 41.811862)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
tri_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_TRI(rast, 1) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(t.rast, 1, o.pt) AS tri_value
FROM tri_rast t, origin o;

WITH hospital_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.409129, 41.811862), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(h.geom, 4326)::geometry, 1000)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r, hospital_geom h
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(h.geom, 4326)::geometry)
),
ruggedness_index AS (
  SELECT ST_RuggednessIndex(rast) AS ruggedness
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ruggedness AS ruggedness_index
FROM ruggedness_index;
